def factor_intraday_volume_price_coordination_rk(df):
    """Correlation between intraday return and rolling rank of volume change, with signed power."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    intraday_ret = df_copy['close'] / df_copy['open'] - 1.0
    vol_chg = df_copy['volume'].pct_change()
    vol_chg_rank = vol_chg.rolling(20, min_periods=10).rank(pct=True)
    corr = intraday_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_chg_rank)
    signal = np.sign(corr) * np.power(np.abs(corr), 1.5)
    signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy['factor_intraday_volume_price_coordination_rk'] = signal
    return df_copy['factor_intraday_volume_price_coordination_rk']
description: Preserves the parent's nonlinear price-volume coordination mechanism but replaces close-to-close return with intraday return (close/open - 1). Intraday return focuses on session price movement that is directly contemporaneous with trading volume, likely strengthening the linear IC and MI without disturbing the signed-power modifier. The rolling rank of volume change remains to dampen outlier volume spikes, and the signed power retains emphasis on strong correlations. This is a single targeted direction adjustment to the price variable, keeping one core mechanism and one lightweight modifier.
